help: usage: fleet-switchboard land-gate [-h] {take,touch,release,status,check,move} ... One gate token per repository in `land_repos`, first come first served. `take <repo>` says HELD or QUEUED (ask again at least every land_gate.expire_minutes, default 10); the holder runs `touch <repo>` while it lands and `release <repo>` when done; a holder that stops touching or whose pod is gone loses the token at once. `status [repo]` shows holder, queue and times. `move <repo> <name> <place>` is the Chief of Staff's. positional arguments: {take,touch,release,status,check,move} take Take the land token of the repository (or ask again for a queued place) touch Show the holder is alive: keeps the token release Give the token up (or leave the queue); the Chief of Staff may name another status The holder, the queue and the times, one line each check Does NAME hold the live token of the repository? Exit 0 yes (or not a land repository), 3 no, with the words; reads only move Put a queued name at a place (1 = next); the Chief of Staff only options: -h, --help show this help message and exit
